mechanisms.timeframes: M15 opening 2h (8x completed M15), M5 native entry checks
mechanisms.hypothesis: Europe 07:00-09:00 UTC establishes 2h directional price displacement, then a 40%-80% retracement with final M15 turning back in original direction between 10:00 and 15:00 UTC. Trend continuation after retracement, neither closed Brent->Crude lead-lag nor rejected 4H oil impulse.
mechanisms.signal: Same calendar-day 8 strictly contiguous completed M15 07:00-09:00 UTC. Initial signed displacement >=1.0x average first8 M15 high-low range. Latest completed M15 has retracement fraction in [0.40,0.80] of initial drive measured against 09:00 opening-drive close; candle body same direction as opening signed displacement. TickVolume latest >=0.65x opening mean. Real original BID/ASK spread <=0.35x latest completed M15 range. Only weekdays 10:00–15:00 UTC, last M15 strictly prior to decision. One signal per newly closed M15.
mechanisms.driver: absolute drive displacement divided by current close, no posterior calibration
mechanisms.exit: existing NativeCausalExitResearch.VolatilityTarget (1.5 ATR quote-side invalidation and 2.5 ATR target) with 150-minute cap, native observed future bid/ask; model min contract volume, common EUR300

mechanisms.timeframes: M15 3h rolling regime and M5 as-of fill

mechanisms.signal: Last 13 strictly contiguous completed M15: first8 prior reference and last4 compression context, last1 breakout bar. Mean high-low last4 <=0.85 times first8; final bar closes beyond first8 highest high or lowest low by >=0.05x first8 mean range; final candle body agrees breakout, latest tickVolume >=1.10x first8 mean; real BID/ASK spread <=0.35x last range. US cash period 17:00–19:30 UTC in 2026-W42/W43 when New York EDT UTC-4. One signal per newly completed M15; no assumed exchange holiday filling.

mechanisms.driver: breakout excess above/below prior8 extreme divided by last close, no outcome-trained model
